name: kokedera-themes
description: Kokedera color and icon themes: shared palettes, file icons, editor extensions and generated ports

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs --out ports && node tools/icons.mjs && node tools/palettes.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --out ports --check && node tools/icons.mjs --check zed && node tools/palettes.mjs --check
